# FLX-3700: a query ceiling flag is outside the range the engine allows

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

--max-query-seconds raises the wall clock a consumer query may take from the engine's 30 seconds to at most 600, and --max-query-memory raises DuckDB's memory limit from 1GiB to at most 16GiB. A value below the engine's own ceiling or above the largest is refused, since a flag only raises the runtime ceiling and never lowers it (a bundle lowers its own limits, and its own value is kept). The message names the flag and its range. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3700
```
